item.title: Cost of Living in Sunshine North Melbourne
item.description:
Everyone asks how expensive is Sunshine North. The real answer depends on your lifestyle. Here is the data.

Read our full Sunshine North suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Sunshine North Expensive?

Sunshine North sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Sunshine North, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
